stemMd: A right triangle has hypotenuse 17 and one leg 8. What is its area?
explanationMd: The other leg is the square root of 17 squared−8 squared, or 15. Area is one half times the perpendicular legs 8 and 15, giving 60.

distractorRationale.d: This multiplies the hypotenuse and leg without finding the perpendicular height.
distractorRationale.b: This treats the hypotenuse as a perpendicular leg.
distractorRationale.c: This omits the one-half factor after finding the other leg.
